title: Stacked layout core: layout prop, viewport breakpoint, single virtualized scroller
description:
Spec first in packages/ui/features/board_stacked_layout.feature, then implement in packages/ui/src/kanban.

Behaviour: layout 'auto' resolves from a matchMedia query on stackedBelowWidth using useSyncExternalStore, with columns as the server snapshot so server rendering and hydration match. Stacked mode renders sections in column order in one scroller, with a sticky header for the current section. Cards keep IssueCard unchanged. Tapping a section header collapses it to the header row; the chevron points down or right rather than sideways, and the 48 px vertical-text collapsed style does not apply. initialScroll and the detailOpen scroll-to-right are horizontal behaviours and do nothing in stacked mode.

Acceptance scenarios: 375 px wide renders sections with no horizontal page or board scroll; 1024 px renders columns unchanged; 667 by 375 (a phone in landscape) and 768 px render columns; 599 px stacks and 600 px does not; resizing across the breakpoint switches layout and keeps the selection; layout='columns' and layout='stacked' override the viewport; stackedBelowWidth changes the threshold; a 500-issue section renders at most 40 cards and scrolls to its last card; the selected card stays rendered and in place after a detail panel opens and closes; collapse state is shared across layouts and persists through columnStateKey; config-collapsed statuses start collapsed; status moves with animated motion and with reduced motion do not throw or leave is-flipping set; no React hydration warning.
